note: Literal synthetic traveller message as it arrives on the Northstar traveller channel. This is the scenario trigger (traveller-requested change). Claims inside are the traveller's own statements: they must be reconciled against booked state and programme data, not trusted as authoritative.
text: Hi! Quick one - my fireside is Thursday afternoon and my flight home leaves Friday just before midnight, basically straight from the closing party. I'd love to stay the weekend: could you move my return to Sunday the 4th instead? I'll cover whatever the extra costs are - flights, hotel nights, transfers, all of it. My only official thing is the fireside itself so nothing should be affected.

extractedClaims.claim: His only programme commitment is the recovery fireside (Thursday 1 Oct afternoon)
Current return departs Friday 2 Oct just before midnight
Requests return moved to Sunday 4 Oct
Volunteers to pay all incremental costs (flights, hotel, transfers)
extractedClaims.note: Traveller-initiated funding declaration; still requires the itemised split to be presented and confirmed before any action (approvalThresholds (4)).
